title: GB F-gas record, report and pre-charged equipment QA controls

sources.title: Record and report F gas and equipment pre-charged with F gas
Import, export or manufacture equipment pre-charged with F gas

facts.source_fact: Businesses must record and report qualifying F-gas production, import, export and destruction activities in Great Britain.
Pre-charged equipment records include equipment type and number of units placed on the GB market.
Records include the quantity and type of F gas in pre-charged equipment.
Declarations of conformity and customs documents are part of relevant import records.
Specified activity thresholds determine whether annual reporting is required.
Annual F-gas activity reports are due by 31 March for the previous calendar year.
Certain high-volume activities require an independent verification document.
Verification deadlines can differ by activity type, including 31 March or 30 June as specified.
Relevant verification documents must be retained for 5 years.
Reported quantities are organisation/activity records and are not parcel-level measurements.
